summary.name: GitLab
summary.one_liner: GitLab is an open-source DevSecOps platform that bundles source control, CI/CD, security scanning and project management into one application.
use_cases: host and browse git source code repositories
set up continuous integration and deployment pipelines
run security scans on code changes
assign code owners as reviewers for file changes
manage a software project from planning to release
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitLab.org/GitLab project repository view on gitlab.com. It shows a branch and tag selector (master is the default and protected branch, with 19 branches and 20 tags listed, mostly ee release tags) and a Code owners section that assigns users and groups as approvers for specific file changes. The meta description describes GitLab as a single application covering source control, CI/CD, security scanning and project management. Little beyond the listing and that description is on the page.
notable: Single application covering the full software development lifecycle
Code owners file assigns approvers for specific file changes
Open-source DevSecOps platform per the page description
caveats: Pricing and plan tiers are not stated on this page
Page shows a repository view only; the code owners table is empty and an error message appeared while loading it
